verdict.rationale: Qodo's own docs show background automation that runs without a user present: once connected it automatically reviews every pull request, can label PR risk, and enforces standards across repositories without manual intervention, with control over when reviews run. This is a fixed, event-triggered PR-review automation, not general user-defined automations. Missing for 10: user-authored custom automations or workflows beyond PR review, recurring or scheduled background runs (only PR-event triggers are documented), detailed docs on configuring triggers, and independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
